hypothesis: A frozen grammar prior learned only from an independently versioned public source roster improves held-out transfer or reduces complete cold artifact plus closure bytes relative to no prior and a hand-coded grammar prior, without private adaptation.
estimand: paired model selection loss and complete cold deployment bytes for each held-out source family and model family

independence_and_accounting.existing_language_calibration_provenance: training_lineages_only; its checksum does not prove public origin or disjointness from heldout families
independence_and_accounting.cold_closure_rule: Charge the complete canonical cold bundle including runtime, shared prior, grammar/codebook, and exact dependency closure; no hash-only or private codebook exclusion.
independence_and_accounting.private_adaptation_rule: Charge every byte and compute operation that depends on private source rows; any private adaptation disqualifies the public-only candidate.

stop_rule: Run exactly one deterministic pilot. Admit a development study only if the pilot fixture passes, a dated and source-disjoint public roster and model/source holdouts are frozen, and complete cold closure accounting is available. Stop with an explicit blocker if any evidence is missing. No automatic campaign or retry.
admission_gates: public training source roster is independently hashed, dated, and disjoint from every heldout source family
public prior payload and all dependencies have immutable hashes, licenses, and exact cold byte costs
no-prior and hand-coded controls use the same heldout models and resource envelope
private adaptation is absent or explicitly charged and separately reported
compatibility and validity gates pass on every heldout source/model cell

pilot_results.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=line-tables-only CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=2 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 cargo test --locked --lib public_prior_pilot -- --nocapture

public_trained_prior.reason: no frozen independent public source roster, prior payload, source-disjoint model holdouts, or payload digest

pilot_results.stop_reason: pilot demonstrated no synthetic fixture gain from the hand-coded prior; no independently sourced public-trained prior or real source/model holdout roster is available, and complete cold closure cannot be measured from the fixture
